sys_generative_ai_config.name: Humanize

parent.display_value: OneExtend Capability Definition: Humanize Text (Now LLM Generic - Now LLM Generic)

sys_generative_ai_config.prompt:
- Humanize this the following text below and put it in a bulleted list, combine bullets where necessary for conciseness, use this bullet •. - Only output the bulleted results, do not provide any subheading or title. - Keep language in layman and simple terms - do not sound too technical, use active voice only, avoid repetition of words. - Each bullet should be no more than 15 words. - If there is REQ number or RITM number, only show the REQ number. - If there is any approval names or groups mentioned, do mention it. - Keep as few bullets as possible and never exceed more than 5 bullets. - Apply the following personality: {{personality}} and make it very apparent in your output, keep it concise and don't add extra bullets.
The text for evaluation is '{{text}}'.
